title: Ghirardelli-Style Marbled Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: Brown-butter and brown sugar cookies with dark and semisweet chocolate, from fine flecks to big melted pockets.
imageAlt: Stack of chocolate chip cookies with dark chocolate shards and melted chocolate pockets
ingredients: 1 cup unsalted butter, divided; soften half
¾ cup packed light brown sugar
¾ cup semisweet chocolate chips, assorted sizes if available
½ cup dark chocolate chips (about 60% cacao)
¾ cup chopped dark or semisweet chocolate bar, including its fine shavings (about 4 ounces)

steps.title: Brown half the butter
steps.text: Melt ½ cup butter in a light-colored saucepan over medium-low heat. Stir along the bottom as it foams. When the flecks turn hazelnut brown and smell toasted, immediately scrape the butter and flecks into a heatproof bowl.

steps.title: Cool until spreadable
steps.text: Let the browned butter cool until lukewarm. Whisk in 1 tablespoon water to replace moisture lost during browning. Stir in the remaining ½ cup softened butter. Chill briefly, stirring occasionally, until opaque and soft enough to hold a spoon mark.

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Line two baking sheets with parchment. Whisk together the flour, baking soda, and salt.

steps.title: Make the dough
steps.text: Beat the cooled butter mixture with the brown and granulated sugars until creamy. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla. Mix in the flour mixture on low just until the dry streaks disappear.

steps.title: Marble the chocolate
steps.text: Chop the chocolate bar unevenly, leaving fine flecks, small shards, and chunks up to about ½ inch. Scatter the shavings and both kinds of chips over the dough. Fold only a few times so the shavings streak through the dough and the larger pieces stay unevenly distributed. Reserve a few chunks for the tops.

steps.title: Bake in batches
steps.text: Scoop heaping tablespoonfuls 2 inches apart and press in the reserved chocolate. Bake one sheet at a time for 9–11 minutes, until the edges are golden and the centers look soft but set. Cool on the pan for 5 minutes before moving to a rack.
